step.bar: 1. Compact filters (a tab or a segmented choice) sit in PageHeader#bar.
step.search: 2. The search sits in the header of the list panel (ListPanel).

settings.title: Settings pages: the authoring contract
settings.source: SettingsPageFrame.vue in src/views/dashboard/settings/components, the route meta in settings/route.ts and the sidebar in src/layouts/dashboard/settingsNavigation.ts.

rule.frame: 1. Every settings page opens with SettingsPageFrame. A page never builds its own PageHeader or PageBody.
rule.title: 2. The title is the titleKey of the page's route meta, and it equals the sidebar word. A page sets title only when the text is computed.
rule.crumb: 3. The crumb reads Settings. A page in a named sidebar group passes that group's word as crumb.
rule.slots: 4. The named slots are actions (header buttons), status and meta (header text), tabs and bar (the header bar) and panel (a panel beside the body).
rule.body: 5. A list with a detail, or a board, sets body="none" and draws its own approved body in the default slot.

settings.reviewNote: Reviewed with 28 destinations in 6 groups. All six groups are kept: each group answers one question, and a seventh group would leave one with fewer than three pages.

review.you: Kept. One personal page, apart from the channel settings.
review.bot: Kept. Everything that changes how the bot talks and behaves.
review.connections: Kept. Every account and platform the bot links to.
review.developers: Kept. The three machine-facing doors: keys, webhooks and feeds.
review.access: Kept. The largest group, ten pages, with one question: who may do what, and what is blocked. Each page has its own icon, so the list stays scannable.
review.account: Kept. The plan, the limits, the person's data and the channel itself.
